resolution: Re-analysis reconciled from the superseded Introduced text to the Engrossed in House (EH) text of record. Material corrections applied to the corrected analysis being balloted: (1) casualty-loss incident-period window corrected to 'on or after December 28, 2019, and before January 1, 2027' (was 'after July 4, 2025'); (2) removed the introduced-text AMT carve-out (56(b)(1)(D)) and standard-deduction add-on (63(c)(1)(C)) — Engrossed uses new 63(b)(8) non-itemizer deduction and the 165(h)(1) $100/$500 floor with no AMT provision; (3) wildfire payment-received window corrected to 'after December 31, 2025' with no upper bound (was 'tax years 2026 through 2030 / before January 1, 2031'), and the wildfire-disaster declaration end date 'before January 1, 2027' added; (4) short title corrected to 'Doug LaMalfa Federal Disaster Tax Relief Certainty Act'; (5) underreported item swapped from the now-absent AMT provision to the Section 2(d)(2) coordination clause deactivating prior-law provisions.
